And in eastern DR Congo, the CRP rebel group halts its advance after coming within dozens of kilometres of the northeastern city of Bunia.

items.title: Egypt: At least 31 dead after fuel truck overturns on highway
items.desc: The accident occurred on the packed Ring Road in Giza near Cairo. Dozens of ambulances responded to the crash, and Egyptian health authorities say the death toll could rise.

items.title: Nigeria detains 5 Mexicans, confiscates over $220 million of meth
items.desc: Nigeria's anti-drug agency said Mexican experts were allegedly recruited by a Nigerian national to run a meth laboratory in the southeastern state of Enugu.
